resources.string: The previous recording stopped to let the phone cool. It will not restart automatically. You can try a new recording when ready.
Quick Record with camera and Stop controls
Your cameras, your screen, your recordings. One place to capture and find them.
Enable only the features you’ll use. You can continue and grant access later.
Screen recording asks for Android consent each time you start.
SOS Mode starts a local camera recording after permission and notification checks. It does not send alerts or contact emergency services.
Recording is unavailable while the phone is too warm or its thermal state cannot be checked. Let it cool, then try again. Recording will not restart automatically.
Capture Every Perspective. Protect Every Moment.
Record with one camera, or try two on supported devices.
Record your whole screen as a silent video.
Play, export or delete your saved videos.
Record camera footage or your screen, then find your videos in Recordings. Dual camera support varies by device. SOS Mode offers quick local recording.
This section is a preview. It cannot record, save, encrypt, or protect recordings yet.
The neon dark theme uses purple accents and clear recording controls. Permissions are requested when needed. Screen capture asks for consent each time. Private recordings are not encrypted.
Choose a camera mode and frame your shot. Recording can continue when you leave. Stop here or from the ongoing notification.
Camera access is needed for live preview and video. Microphone audio is optional.
Microphone off — video will be silent.
Videos stay in private app storage and are not encrypted. Open Recordings from Home to play or export them. Uninstalling removes the originals.
Tap to open Camera Studio. Use Stop recording to finish.
A recording session is in progress. Open Camera Studio for its status.
Notification access is needed so recording status and Stop remain visible. Enable UmbraCam notifications in app settings, then try again.
A previous session ended unexpectedly. Finalized segments were kept; unfinished output remains separate. Start a new recording to capture again.
Session metadata could not be confirmed. Preserved video files are kept; check available storage before recording again.
Resume with the same cameras, layout and microphone settings, or start a new recording.
Camera access is off. Enable it here, or allow it in app settings.
Microphone access was not granted. You can still record silent video.
No supported front or rear camera is available on this device.
The camera is unavailable. Close other camera apps, check privacy controls, then retry.
No supported video profile was found for this camera.
Storage is too low to begin. Free space and try again.
Recording could not start. Check permissions and retry the preview.
Microphone input became unavailable. Recording is stopping.
The video could not be finalized. Unverified output was kept separately; it is not shown as saved.
Stopped before usable video was captured. No video was saved.
A required capture source or recording service was interrupted. Recording is stopping.
A finalized video was preserved after an interruption. Its audio or ending may be incomplete.
Quick Record starts a rear-camera video after the required permissions are granted. The recording stays in your private Recordings library.
Starts a standard rear-camera recording with microphone off. Android permission, notification, thermal and storage checks still apply.
Check whether Android advertises cameras that can run together. This check does not open a camera or microphone.
Android 11 or later is needed for this check
Android 10 does not provide the standard concurrent-camera query. This does not determine what the hardware can do.
Camera support could not be checked
Camera information is restricted. Check device privacy controls, then try again.
The camera service did not return complete information. Try again.
The camera list changed during the check. Try again.

Advertised groups are metadata, not a recording test. Video settings still need validation on this device. Camera Studio can try advertised front-and-rear pairs. Actual availability is checked before recording.
Single-camera recording remains available when a dual pair cannot be used.
Dual mode needs Android 11 or later. You can use Single camera.
Could not check dual cameras. Try again or use Single camera.
No front-and-rear pair is advertised. You can check again or use Single camera.
Dual records one portrait HD (720p) video. Availability depends on your device.
This pair is no longer listed. Check again, choose another pair or use Single camera.
Rear fills the frame; front appears in the top-right inset.
Record your whole screen. Android will ask what you want to share each time you start.

Video fits within 1280 pixels on the longer edge. Protected content may appear blank. Apps can block playback-audio capture. Rotating or resizing the display stops this recording; start again with fresh consent.
Silent screen recording. Tap to open controls.
A front camera is available, but screen + camera composition is not supported by the current capture adapter. Switch to Screen only to record.
This device does not report a front camera. Screen only remains available.
The screen fills the video. Your front camera appears in a small upper-right window.
The screen appears in the upper half and your front camera in the lower half.
Screen and front camera are being recorded without audio. Tap to open controls.
The front camera stopped or could not open. Any valid segment is preserved. Check camera access or switch to Screen only, then start again.
Microphone capture is not available in this screen recorder yet. Videos remain silent.
Playback audio capture is not supported on this Android version.
Android and each app control playback capture. Protected or opted-out apps may produce silence. Grant audio permission to enable this option.
Microphone and app audio are saved as separate synchronized tracks.
An audio source stopped. Capture was stopped and any valid portion was saved.
Screen recording was cancelled. Start again when you are ready.
Finish the current camera recording or file operation before starting the screen recorder.
This device or selected source combination is not supported by the current capture path. Choose Screen only or retry with a supported output format.
Screen capture could not start or continue. Start again to request fresh consent.
Android stopped screen sharing. Any valid video has been preserved. A new recording needs fresh consent.
The display size or orientation changed. This recording has stopped. Start again for the new size.
Screen recording is active or finishing.
Videos stay in private app storage and are not encrypted. Uninstalling removes them. Export a copy to keep it elsewhere.
Video exported. The original is still in Recordings.
The action could not be completed. Refresh recordings and try again.
Export failed. The destination may contain an incomplete copy; your original is unchanged. Try exporting again.
Finish recording or saving before exporting or deleting a video.
Export cancelled. Your recording is unchanged.
This video could not be played. You can try exporting it to another player.
Working… Keep the app open until this finishes.
No recordings yet. Record a camera or your screen, then return here to play or export the video.
Video details could not be read.
The recording from %1$s will be permanently removed from this app. Exported copies will stay where you saved them.
